name: appflowy
description: Operate self-hosted AppFlowy directly through its HTTP API.

interface.shortDescription: Use a self-hosted AppFlowy API directly.
interface.longDescription: Read and manage AppFlowy workspaces, documents, databases, files, sharing, imports, exports, and publishing over the native HTTP API. No MCP adapter is involved.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $appflowy-direct to work with my self-hosted AppFlowy instance.
